working_agreement: Requested 2026-11-13: create the spec and proceed as for turn-steering. Implement the planned slices in order and fix in-scope review findings; commit each slice, push its branch, and open its pull request without asking again. The design's proposals are implemented as written and corrected in review. Ask before merging or publishing.

criteria.a1: An edit or write shows the changed lines before approval and after completion
criteria.a2: A long-running command shows its output while it runs, and its exit status and duration when it ends
criteria.a3: A turn with ten tool calls occupies a bounded number of lines until expanded, and the last collapsed result can be expanded in full
criteria.a4: Rendering of tool calls is identical with thinking shown or hidden; completed calls stay in the transcript and the bottom zone shows every call in flight
criteria.a5: Snapshot tests cover each renderer, running, succeeded, and failed, at a narrow and a wide terminal width
criteria.a6: Every event, including display payloads and errors, survives a JSON round trip and carries a per-session sequence number that increases by one
criteria.a7: A turn rendered from a replayed event log matches the turn rendered live
criteria.a8: Tools produce the display payload, the runtime forwards it, and the CLI renders it; the execution contract has no presentation member; the payload contract holds no module-level state and passes a guarded-import test; a tool without a payload gets a generic one
criteria.a9: Text from the model or a tool cannot move the cursor, erase lines, or imitate the approval question in any renderer

a8.check: src/tools/__tests__/display.test.ts: each built-in tool described before and after a real run, every payload equal to its JSON round trip; a tool that describes nothing, or whose description throws, gets the generic payload; display.ts and lineDiff.ts import only type declarations and reference no process, file, network, clock, or module-level state; execution.ts has no display member (type-level) and createLocalTools hands out tools without describe methods; nothing in src/tools or src/agent-core imports src/ui or src/cli. src/agent-core/__tests__/toolDisplay.test.ts: the runtime forwards the application's descriptions on tool_started, tool_finished, and tool_failed; a description that throws, rejects, or never settles gives the generic payload and the call still runs. src/__tests__/agentToolDisplay.test.ts: through Agent, an edit's hunks are on tool_started before the approval request and on tool_finished after. The CLI rendering the payload is call-renderers. Review fixes: src/__tests__/agentToolDisplay.test.ts, no preview read when read is disabled or outside the active scope; src/agent-core/__tests__/toolDisplay.test.ts, describe hooks get detached copies of arguments, result, and earlier description, and the scope; src/tools/__tests__/display.test.ts and lineDiff.test.ts, diff text capped at 64 KB with a long line cut, a lost final newline shown as -1 +1, the output tail within 16 KB of UTF-8 and never splitting a character, trailing newlines trimmed in linear time. Round 2: src/agent-core/__tests__/toolDisplay.test.ts, the hook gets its own copy of the scope (removing a tool from it does not disable the call; metadata that cannot be copied is left out) and a description that blocks the event loop past 250 ms is dropped; src/tools/__tests__/lineDiff.test.ts and display.test.ts, the diff search stops at its deadline and a 1 MB worst case is shown as one replacement. Round 3: toolDisplay.test.ts, a hook that works 200 ms before its first await and never settles holds the tool under 380 ms (456 ms with the fix reverted). Each fails with its fix reverted. npm test passed (147 suites, 2,612 tests); build, format check, fallow audit, and the tools and agent-core examples passed locally.

slices.note: Merged 2026-11-14 as propio-agent#110 (merge commit c0330451fb5b27a8a94c5676b72485415ef8c9ad) after three review rounds: round 1, six findings (preview reads ignored read's enabled state and scope; hooks could mutate execution arguments and results; diff text had no byte cap; final-newline changes were invisible; quadratic trailing-newline trim; tail limit counted UTF-16 units), fixed in 3b1fadd; round 2, two findings (the hook shared the authorization scope's set; a blocking hook could win the budget race and the diff had no time bound), fixed in c9fe9b4, with the large-file test checking its result instead of wall-clock time after CI on Node 24 (a168a36); round 3, the budget timer started after the hook's synchronous work, fixed in c736571. Labels are still drawn, read off the payload; call-renderers replaces them. Departures from the design are listed in design.md.
Per-kind renderers with snapshots, single layout, bottom zone for all calls in flight, /expand and Ctrl+O, removal of ToolCallView and label fields. Covers the after-completion half of a1.
The approval prompt renders the payload of the call it asks about. Covers the before-approval half of a1.
onOutput in the execution context and shell runner, tool_output events, live tail through the holdable stream.
JSON event forms, per-session numbering, in-memory log, parser, event-driven turn rendering, replay test.
